description: List Ready4Bots levels R0 through R4, plus seal variants R4-N and R4-W. R3: purchase-ready – the agent reaches checkout; only the final purchase step is not yet verified. R4: Purchase demonstrably completed – via a test purchase in test mode or an agreed, immediately cancelled order, via a verified bot purchase report, or via shop logs with spot check. We never trigger real orders at third-party shops. The free check awards R0 through R3 only.
